question.text: A rigid nitrogen tank stored inside a laboratory has a pressure of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn></math> atm at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>06</mn><mo>:</mo><mn>00</mn></math> am when the temperature is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>27</mn><mo> </mo><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>. At <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>03</mn><mo>:</mo><mn>00</mn><mi>pm</mi></math>, when the temperature is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>45</mn><mo> </mo><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math>, the pressure in the tank will be _____ atm. [nearest integer]

solution.text:
According to Gay Lussac law At constant volume and mole

P1T1=P2T2

30300=P2318

P2=30300×318=31.8≈32
